title: How fast is the first token?

scenes.heading: The client is waiting for token one
scenes.sub: Fast streaming can follow a slow start.
voice: A model may stream tokens quickly once it starts.
For the client, the wait from sending the request to seeing the first token is a separate concern.
scenes.result: Wait ends at the first token

scenes.heading: Benchmark a repeatable workload
scenes.sub: Warm up before measuring steady state.
voice: On a supported inference recipe, the performance check deploys Dynamo with a vLLM-served model.
AIPerf warms it up, then sends a repeatable measured workload against that deployment.
scenes.result: Warm-up stays out of the result

scenes.heading: Read latency and output rate
voice: Look at the ninety-ninth percentile of time to first token to see the slow end of requests.
Output tokens per second measures how fast the service produced text.

scenes.heading: Check both limits
scenes.sub: Compare this workload against the recipe.
voice: AICR compares both measurements with the recipe's thresholds.
When interpreting the result, keep the tested model and workload parameters in view because they define the benchmark.

payoff: Read startup latency and steady-state throughput as separate checks against recipe thresholds.
